meta_title: AI Engine Part Reference Finder — FleetAi
meta_description: Enter your engine's brand and serial number: FleetAi's AI assistant identifies the exact model and finds your part's reference, with its source. Free, no account needed.
hero_title: Need a part for your engine?
hero_subtitle: Enter the brand and serial number, describe the part: the assistant identifies the exact model and only quotes verified references, never invented ones.
composer_placeholder: Describe the part you are looking for: impeller, spark plug, anode…
identification_failed_text: Your engine could not be matched to the catalog. You can still describe your part: the assistant will point you to the retailer catalogs.
result_no_reference: This model has no verified reference in our corpus for this part yet. Use the retailer catalogs below: the exploded view gives the exact reference.
result_no_match: No part of our nomenclature matches your request. Start a new search with a different wording, or go straight to your brand's retailer catalogs.
result_disclaimer: Always check the reference on your engine's exploded view before ordering.
result_cta_title: Find your parts in two clicks
result_cta_text: Create your FleetAi account: your engines saved once and for all, the nomenclature by assembly and your parts list to order — no more retyping the serial number.
quota_exhausted_title: You have used your free searches
quota_exhausted_text: Create your account to keep going: prefilled engines, the full nomenclature and the AI assistant are waiting.

reference.label: Manufacturer reference
reference.unverified: Not re-verified — check it on the exploded view before ordering.

retailers.title: Find the reference on the exploded view
retailers.intro: Exploded views belong to the retailer catalogs: open your brand's catalog, enter the model code and look for the "{catalogLabel}" assembly. Parts carry a clickable callout number giving the official name and the reference.
retailers.modelCodeMissing: The model code was not identified: read it on your engine's identification plate before opening the catalog.
retailers.sourceNote: Indicative references and prices collected from retailer catalogs (Partzilla, Boats.net, Crowley Marine) — always double-check on your engine's exploded view before ordering.
